notes: upstream_lean_toolchain is the lean-toolchain file at the pinned commit; build_lean_toolchain is examples/lean-toolchain, the toolchain Anneal builds the vendored sources with.

The LM-1.1 brief cites rustc commit 8144389c895da997dbdecaa635e44d6a50be6ffd; upstream/.pins/rustc.commit at the pinned commit records 8144389c895da997dbdecaa635e41d6a50be6ffd, which is authoritative.
upstream_git_objects are git object ids at the pinned commit (`git rev-parse <commit>:<path>` in a clone of the repository); the audit recomputes them from the vendored bytes and file modes.
